Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
items.excerpt: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters. Benchmark scores are only available for a smaller 30B test model so far, and Z.ai is positioning GLM-5.4 as the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models. items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
items.excerpt: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. items.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
items.excerpt: US intelligence agencies tracked contacts between Alice Huang and China's Ministry of State Security for over a year, the New York Times reports. The surveillance ran parallel to her secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Federal investigators are now looking into whether a network of companies in Southeast Asia was used to smuggle AI chips into China in violation of US export controls. Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before the US House of Representatives on December 1. The article US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year appeared…
